convergence.iterationNotes: Iteration 1 (authored from CDP DOMSnapshot scene graphs of the normalized prototype: paint-ordered draw list, per-line text boxes, opacity-context grouping, svg path harvest, synthesized input-value/placeholder text, modeled range-input track/fill/thumb): 1.09-2.30% - two systematic defects surfaced: text placed 3-4px low (an HTML-side calibration reference error; the real-page evidence re-confirmed GC-001's model - pen centers the font's unrounded hhea box in the lineHeight box, Heebo 1.0479/0.4209, Noto Serif 1.069/0.293) and a slider-gradient parse bug (fill stop read as 0%). Iteration 2 (hhea-based text placement + slider fix): all states 0.26-0.74% except entry-error 1.43% - the reference-screenshot rasters were cropped at default's subpixel phase while entry-error's un-hidden helper line shifts the shots box +20.5px to a different phase. Iteration 3 (per-phase asset crops + per-(family,weight,size) subpixel text tunes measured from real textboxes): all 20 states 0.25-0.90%, standard met. Residual diff is cross-rasterizer text/edge anti-aliasing (pen vs Chromium), concentrated on glyph edges and 1px control borders. default==static-print exports are byte-identical, matching the contract's identical-by-construction claim.

All pass.
